labels.name: needs-kurt
labels.description: Needs Kurt: an account, a decision or real content

milestones.title: M1 · Setup
milestones.description: Repo, Cloudflare Workers deploy, design tokens, theme toggle, uncbidyo.org DNS on Cloudflare.

milestones.title: M2 · Public site
milestones.description: All wireframe sections built as components with placeholder content, responsive and accessible.

milestones.title: M3 · Data (Supabase)
milestones.description: Supabase project, schema, storage and security rules; site sections read real data.

milestones.title: M4 · Booking
milestones.description: Request form saves to the database, enforces the 7-day rule and sends emails.

milestones.title: M5 · Admin
milestones.description: Invite-only dashboard: requests inbox with accept/decline, albums, team, organizations.

milestones.title: M6 · Launch
milestones.description: Real content, performance, SEO and accessibility checks, uncbidyo.org switched to the new site.

issues.title: Scaffold Next.js 16 project for Cloudflare Workers
issues.body:
Next.js 16 + Tailwind 4 + OpenNext Cloudflare adapter, design tokens, self-hosted fonts, theme toggle, placeholder home page.

- [x] `npm run build` and `opennextjs-cloudflare build` pass
- [x] Worker size under 3 MiB (≈1 MB gzip)
- [x] Light/dark toggle persists across reloads

issues.title: Create GitHub org and push the repo
issues.body:
Using the BIDYO org email.

- [ ] GitHub account on the org email
- [ ] Organization `uncbidyo` created, Kurt invited as Owner
- [ ] Private repo `bidyo-web` created and code pushed to `main`

issues.title: Create Cloudflare account and connect Workers Builds
issues.body:
- [ ] Cloudflare account on the org email (Free plan), Kurt invited as Administrator
- [ ] Workers & Pages → Import repository → `bidyo-web`
- [ ] Build: `npx opennextjs-cloudflare build` · Deploy: `npx wrangler deploy`
- [ ] Non-production branch deploy: `npx wrangler versions upload`
- [ ] First deploy live on `*.workers.dev`

issues.title: Move uncbidyo.org DNS to Cloudflare
issues.body:
Domain stays registered at Vercel for now.

- [ ] Check renewal date in Vercel
- [ ] Add uncbidyo.org to Cloudflare (Free), compare imported records with Vercel's (site, MX, TXT)
- [ ] Records pointing to Vercel set to DNS only (grey cloud)
- [ ] DNSSEC off in Vercel (if it was on), wait 24h
- [ ] Vercel → Domains → uncbidyo.org → Nameservers → Edit → Cloudflare's two nameservers
- [ ] Cloudflare shows the zone as Active

issues.title: Attach new.uncbidyo.org preview domain
issues.body:
- [ ] Workers → bidyo-web → Domains & Routes → Custom domain `new.uncbidyo.org`
- [ ] Old site still served on `uncbidyo.org`

issues.title: Branch protection and PR workflow
issues.body:
- [ ] Protect `main`: changes go through pull requests
- [ ] Each PR gets a Cloudflare preview link
- [ ] Add a CI check: lint + typecheck + build

issues.title: Navbar and mobile menu
issues.body:
- [ ] Sticky, shrinks after scrolling
- [ ] Links: Work, Services, How it works, Team, FAQ; theme toggle; Book a shoot
- [ ] Phone: full-screen menu sheet, focus trapped, Esc closes

issues.title: Hero with background reel
issues.body:
Beyonk-style background video.

- [ ] Reel on the right 60% at 50% opacity, masked to fade before the headline
- [ ] Phones: full-bleed at 35% with bottom fade
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` / save-data → poster image
- [ ] “Watch the reel” opens the full reel with sound in a modal
- [ ] Headline, intro, Book a shoot CTA, 7-day note

issues.title: Proof strip (5+ organizations)
issues.body:
- [ ] Crimson band with the count and organization names/logos
- [ ] Falls back to the number alone when no names are approved

issues.title: Services list
issues.body:
- [ ] Four rows: Event Coverage, Photoshoot, Video Shoot, Film Making
- [ ] Row fills crimson on hover; photo preview follows cursor on desktop
- [ ] Click opens booking form with that service pre-selected

issues.title: Album section with filters
issues.body:
- [ ] Filters: All · Portrait · Video · Album (Facebook)
- [ ] Dense grid of slow-crossfading tiles with title + date captions
- [ ] Portrait → lightbox gallery; Video → player; Album → opens Facebook album in new tab
- [ ] Respects reduced motion

issues.title: How it works (4 steps)
issues.body: Send a request → We review it → We plan together → Shoot & deliver, with the 7-day rule.

issues.title: Who we serve cards
issues.body: Organizations / Faculty & offices / Students. Each opens the form with “Requesting as” pre-selected.

issues.title: About and team grid
issues.body:
- [ ] Group photo + “We are UNC BIDYO.” copy
- [ ] Team grid with hover photo swap, advisers first, “Show all” after 8

issues.title: FAQ accordion
issues.body: Booking lead time, how the rate works, deliverables, off-campus events, photo usage.

issues.title: Booking section UI
issues.body:
Form layout only (submission in M4).

- [ ] Fields: name, email, phone, requesting as, organization, event title, dates, services, crew, **proposed rate (₱)**, deliverables
- [ ] Start date picker blocks dates < today + 7
- [ ] Also opens as a modal from every Book button

issues.title: Footer
issues.body: White logo, motto, address, socials, Book a shoot.

issues.title: Responsive, accessibility and performance pass
issues.body:
- [ ] 360px → 1440px with no horizontal scroll
- [ ] Keyboard and screen reader check, visible focus rings
- [ ] Contrast checked in both themes
- [ ] Lighthouse ≥ 90 on mobile

issues.title: Collect hero reel and sample photos
issues.body:
- [ ] Short muted loop (≤20s, MP4 + WebM, ~4 MB) and a poster frame
- [ ] Full reel link (YouTube/Facebook)
- [ ] 6–10 photos per category for placeholders

issues.title: Create Supabase project on the org account
issues.body:
- [ ] Supabase org on the org email, Kurt invited
- [ ] Project in the closest region (Singapore)
- [ ] Keys stored as Cloudflare secrets and in `.dev.vars` locally

issues.title: Database schema and migrations
issues.body:
Tables in `supabase/migrations`:

- [ ] `requests` (contact, org, requester type, event, dates, services, crew, proposed_rate, deliverables, status pending/accepted/declined, decided_by, decided_at, notes)
- [ ] `albums` (title, category portrait/video/facebook, facebook_url, cover, date, order, visible)
- [ ] `media` (album_id, type, path/url, caption, order)
- [ ] `team_members`, `organizations`
- [ ] `profiles` with role owner/approver

issues.title: Row-level security and roles
issues.body:
- [ ] Public: insert into `requests` only; read visible albums/media/team/orgs
- [ ] Approver: read requests, update status
- [ ] Owner: everything
- [ ] Tests for each policy

issues.title: Storage buckets and image resizing
issues.body:
- [ ] Buckets for album media and team photos
- [ ] Resized/WebP delivery (Supabase transforms or Cloudinary)
- [ ] Custom Next image loader

issues.title: Site sections read from the database
issues.body: Album, team and organizations come from Supabase; pages rebuild or revalidate on change (switch OpenNext cache to KV/R2 if needed).

issues.title: Submit requests to the database
issues.body:
- [ ] Server action / route handler validates with a shared schema
- [ ] 7-day rule enforced server-side
- [ ] Friendly success and error states

issues.title: Spam protection
issues.body: Cloudflare Turnstile on the form + basic rate limiting.

issues.title: Set up Resend on uncbidyo.org
issues.body:
- [ ] Resend account on the org email
- [ ] Domain verified (SPF/DKIM records added in Cloudflare)
- [ ] Decide which inbox receives new-request notifications

issues.title: Request emails
issues.body:
- [ ] Client: “Request received”
- [ ] BIDYO: new request notification with all details
- [ ] Client: accepted / declined (with optional note)

issues.title: Admin sign-in (invite only)
issues.body:
- [ ] `/admin` behind Supabase Auth, no public sign-up
- [ ] Owner can invite users and set role (approver)

issues.title: Requests inbox with accept/decline
issues.body:
- [ ] List with filters (pending/accepted/declined), sorted by event date
- [ ] Detail view; accept/decline with note → triggers email
- [ ] Records who decided and when

issues.title: Album manager
issues.body:
- [ ] Create albums: Portrait/Video uploads, or Facebook link + cover
- [ ] Reorder, hide/show, captions

issues.title: Team and organizations manager
issues.body: Add/edit officers (photo + hover photo, role, order) and served organizations (name, logo, show).

issues.title: Decide approver access
issues.body: Confirm whether the President gets the approver role, and who else (if anyone).

issues.title: Real content pass
issues.body:
- [ ] Service descriptions and FAQ answers
- [ ] 5+ organization names (with their OK)
- [ ] Final team list and photos
- [ ] Albums uploaded

issues.title: SEO and social sharing
issues.body: Titles, descriptions, Open Graph image, sitemap, robots, favicon set.

issues.title: Final QA
issues.body: Both themes, phones/tablets/desktop, Lighthouse, accessibility audit, form end-to-end test.

issues.title: Switch uncbidyo.org to the new site
issues.body:
- [ ] Remove old Vercel DNS records for `uncbidyo.org` and `www`
- [ ] Add both as custom domains on the `bidyo-web` Worker
- [ ] Remove the domain from the old Vercel project
- [ ] Optional: transfer registration to Cloudflare Registrar (after 60 days)
